dialogues.speaker: Iratxa
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, yeah. I'm looking for this guy, Thianges. Been chasing him from Yilong Wharf all the way to Nasha Town.

dialogues.speaker: Iratxa
dialogues.text: He's... Let's just say he's a friend of mine. And there's lots of things we can talk about together. So many things, in fact, that I think it's best to drag him back to Fontaine so we can sit down and have a nice, long chat...

dialogues.speaker: Iratxa
dialogues.text: Theoretically, he should be in town right now. So why can't I find him?
